title: Return 503 when the Governance approval owner is not configured
summary: Fixed 500 INTERNAL_ERROR when no Governance approval owner URL is configured (neither PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_APPROVAL_API_URL nor PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_SERVICE_URL). Updated ActionUnavailableError in command_adapters/base.py to inherit from both HTTPException and ValueError, and updated governance_approval_url to catch RuntimeError from unconfigured backend and raise ActionUnavailableError with downstream_status=503, error_code='DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE', and retryable=True. In command_executor.py, unified _governance_approval_url to delegate to governance_approval_url, eliminating duplicate resolution logic. Both command route (POST /bff/v1/commands) and approval list reads (GET /bff/approvals, GET /api/v1/approval-decisions) now return standard 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE envelopes with retryable=True. Net production line count change is +12 lines (well within the 15-line budget).

evidence_reproduction.evidence: Prior to fix, submitting a command carrying approval evidence (e.g. ApproveDeployment with approvalId='appr-dp-001') to POST /bff/v1/commands with Governance owner unconfigured caused RuntimeError from governance_approval_url to escape submit_command_admission, resulting in 500 INTERNAL_ERROR with retryable=False.

unconfigured_or_unreachable_governance_o.evidence: With ActionUnavailableError inheriting from HTTPException and ValueError, an unconfigured Governance approval owner yields 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE retryable=True on both POST /bff/v1/commands and GET /bff/approvals / GET /api/v1/approval-decisions. Direct execution via command_executor also yields 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE retryable. A configured owner answering normally continues to return 200 on approvals list and admits commands with 202.

test_suite_drives_real_routes.evidence: services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_governance_owner_unconfigured_503.py drives POST /bff/v1/commands and GET /bff/approvals / GET /api/v1/approval-decisions with unconfigured owner and asserts the 503 envelope (code='DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE', retryable=True, meta.correlationId).

all_scoped_tests_pass_without_regression.evidence: All 4 tests in test_governance_owner_unconfigured_503.py pass. Related suites pass without regression: test_command_executor.py (22 passed), test_governance_router.py (8 passed), test_bff_approvals_surface_contract.py (11 passed), test_tenant_fallback_audit.py (124 passed, 1 skipped), test_bff_test_architecture.py (39 passed), http_smoke_test.py (1 passed).

classifications.rationale: RuntimeError escaped get_base_url when Governance approval owner was unconfigured; fixed by raising typed ActionUnavailableError(503, DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, retryable=True).
Unified _governance_approval_url with base.py governance_approval_url to align error handling and eliminate duplicate resolution.
Added test suite verifying 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE envelope across command route, approval list routes, and command executor.

net_prod_line_budget.evidence: Production code changes in command_adapters/base.py (+28, -3) and command_executor.py (+9, -22) yield a net change of +12 lines, strictly under the 15 net production line budget for change_class=corrective. No compressed code used.
